name: fiantaichean
text: Fiantaichean is a MacKillop headword. The label sits under the Fianna cross-reference in the dictionary. MacKillop records it as the Scottish Gaelic form of the Irish Fianna. The note directs the reader to the Fianna entry for the full record.

attributes.attribute: Scottish Gaelic form of the Irish Fianna, per MacKillop
